svg.aria-label: Projects. PMAY-U 2.0 · IFMS Multi-State API Integration (Apr 2026 – Present): State IFMS APIs (Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, …) consumed and integrated into the PMAY-U 2.0 portal. ASP.NET Web Forms modules on a SQL Server backend for state-wise financial and applicant data. [HTML, CSS, JavaScript] Voice-Activated Virtual Assistant — Python · May – Aug 2023: Runs everyday voice commands using speech recognition and text-to-speech. [Python, SpeechRecognition, TTS] Typing Speed Game + To-Do List — Desktop app · 2022: Typing test with real-time WPM, timer logic and a built-in to-do list. [Python, Tkinter]
